title: Inference on the Value of Policy Improvement in Adaptive Experiments
abstract: arXiv:2610.15789v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper, we develop an asymptotically normal estimator for the value of policy improvement (VPI) under adaptively collected data. This value, which is defined as the gap between the value of the best treatment policy in a class and that of a baseline policy, gauges whether or not it is worth deploying a personalized treatment policy. Building an estimator for the VPI is naturally more difficult than estimating the value of a fixed policy. This is because, in addition to contending with the correlated data and decaying propensities associated with adaptive experiments, any estimator must also handle the non-regularity, or lack of pathwise differentiability, of the underlying estimand when the optimal policy is non-unique. Our proposed estimator works by sequentially fitting a weighted empirical welfare maximizing policy on historical data and then evaluating it using inverse propensity weighting on future samples. translated_title: 自适应实验中策略改进价值的推断
translated_abstract: 本文针对自适应收集的数据，开发了策略改进价值（VPI）的渐近正态估计量。该价值被定义为某一类策略中最优处理策略的价值与基线策略价值之间的差距，用于衡量是否值得部署个性化处理策略。构建VPI的估计量天然比估计固定策略的价值更为困难。这是因为，除了要应对自适应实验中数据相关性和倾向得分衰减的问题之外，当最优策略不唯一时，任何估计量还必须处理目标估计对象的非正则性（即路径可微性的缺失）。我们提出的估计量的工作原理是：先在历史数据上依次拟合加权经验福利最大化策略，然后在未来的样本上使用逆倾向加权对其进行评估。我们既不假设……
tldr: 本文提出了自适应实验数据下策略改进价值（VPI）的渐近正态估计量，通过在历史数据上拟合加权经验福利最大化策略并用逆倾向加权进行评估，克服了数据相关性、倾向得分衰减以及最优策略非唯一时的非正则性等难题，为判断是否值得部署个性化处理策略提供了统计推断工具。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an asymptotically normal estimator for the value of policy improvement (VPI) under adaptively collected data, sequentially fitting a weighted empirical welfare maximizing policy on historical data and evaluating it via inverse propensity weighting, thereby overcoming challenges of correlated data, decaying propensities, and non-regularity when the optimal policy is non-unique.
